preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 15 for k in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) <= 15])
preconditions.description: Each test case's k is between 1 and 15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2*k + 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each row of the grid has exactly 2k + 1 elements (organs or E).

preconditions.expression: all('E' in line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly one 'E' in the grid.

preconditions.expression: all(all(str(i) in line for i in range(1, 4*k + 2)) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: All organs from 1 to 4k + 1 are present exactly once in the grid.

postconditions.expression: any('SURGERY COMPLETE' in line for line in stdout.splitlines()) or any('SURGERY FAILED' in line for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output must start with either 'SURGERY COMPLETE' or 'SURGERY FAILED'.

postconditions.expression: all('DONE' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if 'SURGERY COMPLETE' in line)
postconditions.description: If 'SURGERY COMPLETE' is printed, the output must end with 'DONE'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) <= 10**4 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and not line.strip() in ['SURGERY COMPLETE', 'SURGERY FAILED', 'DONE'])
postconditions.description: Each line of moves or shortcuts (excluding 'SURGERY COMPLETE', 'SURGERY FAILED', and 'DONE') has length at most 10^4.

postconditions.expression: all('=' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip().isupper() and line.strip() != 'DONE')
postconditions.description: If shortcuts are defined, each line must be in the form 'SHORTCUT = move_sequence'.

postconditions.expression: all('SURGERY COMPLETE' in line and any('=' in shortcut_line for shortcut_line in stdout.splitlines() if shortcut_line.strip().isupper()) or 'SURGERY COMPLETE' in line and not any('=' in shortcut_line for shortcut_line in stdout.splitlines() if shortcut_line.strip().isupper()))
postconditions.description: If shortcuts are used, they must be defined before the main sequence of moves.

postconditions.expression: all('SURGERY COMPLETE' in line and any('DONE' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'DONE'))
postconditions.description: If 'SURGERY COMPLETE' is printed, 'DONE' must appear exactly once at the end.

postconditions.expression: all('SURGERY FAILED' in line and len(stdout.splitlines()) == 1 for line in stdout.splitlines() if 'SURGERY FAILED' in line)
postconditions.description: If 'SURGERY FAILED' is printed, it must be the only line of output for that test case.
